The petitioner apprehends his arrest in connection with Munger Mahila P.S. Case No. 53 of 2019,

sentences.text: The learned counsel for the informant has submitted that the petitioner shall obey the terms and conditions of compromise and shall provide the rest amount of Rs. 5,75,000/- within nine months.

Considering the above-mentioned facts and circumstances, let the petitioner, in the event of his arrest or surrender within four weeks before the learned court below, be released provisionally on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Ten Thousand) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Judicial Magistrate 1 st Class, Munger in connection with Munger Mahila P.S. Case No. 53 of 2019, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) Cr.P.C.
After payment of all the amount within the stipulated period of time, the learned court below shall confirm the bail bond of the petitioner.
In the meantime, the informant shall also adhere to his words and shall withdraw all the cases against the petitioner.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.38185 of 2022(6) dt.19-04-2023
With these observations, the petition is disposed of.
Office shall ensure that all defects are removed by the petitioner within the stipulated time provided hereinabove, failing which the matter shall be brought to the notice of this Court.

(Nawneet Kumar Pandey, J)

opennyai_summary.decision:
The learned counsel for the informant has submitted that the petitioner shall obey the terms and conditions of compromise and shall provide the rest amount of Rs. 5,75,000/- within nine months.
Considering the above-mentioned facts and circumstances, let the petitioner, in the event of his arrest or surrender within four weeks before the learned court below, be released provisionally on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Ten Thousand) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Judicial Magistrate 1 st Class, Munger in connection with Munger Mahila P.S. Case No. 53 of 2019, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) Cr.P.C.
After payment of all the amount within the stipulated period of time, the learned court below shall confirm the bail bond of the petitioner.
In the meantime, the informant shall also adhere to his words and shall withdraw all the cases against the petitioner.
With these observations, the petition is disposed of.
Office shall ensure that all defects are removed by the petitioner within the stipulated time provided hereinabove, failing which the matter shall be brought to the notice of this Court.
